scene.style: flat vector illustration of satin-stitch embroidery outlines on a notebook cover, thread-line texture is the only permitted texture, no fabric grain, no photorealism, no 3D

backdrop.note: no sky, stars, or moon in this scene — this is a tabletop/notebook composition, not the Feed's night scene

notebook.shape: flat rectangle notebook/journal, slightly angled, filling the lower two-thirds of frame
notebook.spine: visible running-stitch binding along the left edge, thread color #948e84

hoop.shape: flat circle, embroidery hoop outline stitched onto the notebook cover, centered in upper two-thirds of frame
hoop.stitch_edge: satin-stitch outline, outer ring thread color #a57534 opacity 15%, inner ring thread color #94e6ee opacity 15%
hoop.note: the hoop's interior sits behind the center safe zone, but nothing else should render inside it

thread_details.placement: loose running-stitch thread lines trailing from the hoop's edge, left and right thirds only, kept clear of frame center

stitch_path.style: short running-stitch thread line, visible only in the lower third, fading to nothing as it approaches the center safe zone
stitch_path.glow: none — no emblem exists yet to cast light, keep the thread matte
stitch_path.object: single flat stitched folder-tab icon, soft blur #94e6ee, resting at the stitch line's near end

safe_zones.name: logo_zone
safe_zones.description: must stay flat, empty, and unobstructed — the real product logo (a separate vector asset) will be composited here in code. Do not draw any emblem, mark, or focal object inside this circle.

safe_zones.name: copy_zone
safe_zones.description: must stay flat solid #16181c with no scene elements — the real HTML headline, subhead, and button render here outside the image.

style_keywords: background plate designed to have a separate logo asset composited on top
same family accent palette as the Feed empty-state asset, different scene medium (embroidery, not night sky)
negative_prompt: any emblem, badge, icon, or focal mark in the center
fabric grain or woven texture beyond the stitch lines
moon, sky, stars, or road (reserved for the Feed asset)
